profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Humana

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Migrated entire backend EHR integration from DrChrono to ECW after acquisition
• Migrated entire backend EHR integration from ECW to Athena Health
• Designed and built new backend systems to support in clinic iOS experiences using HL7 FHIR R4, DSTU2, HL7v2
• Backend API development using Java 8+, Kotlin, Postgres, AWS, Jenkins, Nomad, Git

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Acquired by Humana

Key contributor in the design and development of Heal's backend systems that empower operation coordinators and health providers across the nation

• Design and development of Heal's propriety EHR using HL7 FHIR v4 and Aidbox
• Integrations with various vendors, including Health Gorilla for lab orders, When I Work for scheduling, and more
• Salesforce development/ecosystem experience using Apex, SOQL, Lightning, Change Sets
• Java 8+, Kotlin, Postgres, AWS, Jenkins, Nomad, Git

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Built and maintained backend EMR integrations ecosystem responsible for syncing appointment and patient data thats used to power core features like reputation campaigns, online scheduling, and more.

• Infrastructure/System design experience using Serverless, Step Functions, Lambda, SQS, DynamoDB
• Feature development in PHP 7 (Laravel), Nodejs, MySQL.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Design and development of Nordstromrack.com and Hautelook.com scalable core eCommerce API's that are responsible for checkout and payment processing, customer management, and transaction life cycle.

• Seamlessly migrated 3rd party payment processor including millions of customer credit cards.
• Implemented back end support for Apple Pay, lifting conversion and increasing revenue.
• Application development using PHP 5 (Zend & Symfony), PHPUnit, Scala, Akka, Specs2, RabbitMQ, and MySQL.
• Infrastructure experience using AWS RDS, ECS, and Elasticache.
• Continuous integration and deployment using CircleCI, Travis, and Jenkins.
• Monitoring and logging hundreds of KPI's using New Relic, Loggly, and Datadog.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Sony Pictures Entertainment – Developed a software application responsible for managing international licensing information for Sony's TV and film products.

     • Front end Angular2/JavaScript/XHTML debugging and development
     • Application development using Java, Seam, Spring, Hibernate, and PL/SQL
     • Business Logic development using Drools
     • Automated testing using Selenium
     • Oracle SQL optimization using SQL Trace and TKPROF
     • Managing team resources and client communications

DirecTV/AT&T – Responsible for assisting in the design and implementation of a set top box ad delivery reporting suite using SPLUNK dashboards, SPL, and Oracle PL/SQL.

PDG Labs –  Involved in research of development of various in house projects. Projects include:

• Horizontally scaling availability search for features films and TV Series. Main responsibilities include server virtualization using ESXi 5.5 and vCenter.
• Tax incentivized project planning application. Lead our 2016 team of 8 interns build a Spring, Angular, Java, PostgreSQL web application with the goal of maximizing film production budgets through the use of intelligent tax incentivized planning.

positions.title: ITS Service Desk Student Assistant Lead
positions.locationName: 1st Grande Ave San Luis Obispo CA, 93407
positions.description: Provided first-tier technical support for students, faculty, and staff. Managed user accounts and security requests.
